svg.title: One brand, every touchpoint
svg.desc: On the left, what a brand keeps in files: reality, positioning, voice, identity, tokens, canon, references, rules, decisions and memory. The lines merge into one Klein blue square, the brand. On the right, every output: decks, site, product, packaging, campaigns, social, video and 3D. Each output passes a judgment gate, and every pick, kill and edit runs back into memory.
